A '''memory crystal''' was a device used to store information.

==History==
One such crystal, the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber crystal]], was in the possession of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] and contained a list of potentially [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|infants]]. It was highly valuable to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as it contained information crucial to the future of the Order. The Kyber crystal was stolen by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] at the behest of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].
